title: Fibonacci-ish
statementMd:
Yash has recently learnt about the Fibonacci sequence and is very excited about it. He calls a sequence Fibonacci-ish if

1. the sequence consists of at least two elements
2. $*f*_{0}$ and $*f*_{1}$ are arbitrary
3. $*f*_{*n* + 2} = *f*_{*n* + 1} + *f*_{*n*}$ for all $*n* ≥ 0$.

You are given some sequence of integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. Your task is rearrange elements of this sequence in such a way that its longest possible prefix is Fibonacci-ish sequence.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$) — the length of the sequence $*a*_{*i*}$.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($|*a*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9}$).

## Output

Print the length of the longest possible Fibonacci-ish prefix of the given sequence after rearrangement.

## Note

In the first sample, if we rearrange elements of the sequence as $- 1$, $2$, $1$, the whole sequence $*a*_{*i*}$ would be Fibonacci-ish.

In the second sample, the optimal way to rearrange elements is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16f1f7e35511b29cb1396890ca2fb7dfa4d428de.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4003973f16750522e492d7d79318d7e2f0ff99cd.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/87b18fd9524b11e12faf154302fb14c1b55556fb.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b8950ea952476baea26e03281fa2f7640b6241ef.png), $28$.
statementZhMd:
Yash 最近学习了 Fibonacci 数列，对此感到非常兴奋。他将满足以下条件的数列称为类 Fibonacci 数列：

1. 数列至少包含两个元素；
2. $*f*_{0}$ 和 $*f*_{1}$ 可以是任意值；
3. 对所有 $*n* ≥ 0$，满足 $*f*_{*n* + 2} = *f*_{*n* + 1} + *f*_{*n*}$。

给定一个整数序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。你的任务是重新排列该序列中的元素，使其尽可能长的前缀为类 Fibonacci 数列。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$）——序列 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的长度。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$|*a*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

输出重新排列给定序列后，其最长可能的类 Fibonacci 前缀的长度。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，如果将序列中的元素重新排列为 $- 1$、$2$、$1$，那么整个序列 $*a*_{*i*}$ 都将是类 Fibonacci 数列。

在第二个样例中，最优的重新排列方式为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16f1f7e35511b29cb1396890ca2fb7dfa4d428de.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4003973f16750522e492d7d79318d7e2f0ff99cd.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/87b18fd9524b11e12faf154302fb14c1b55556fb.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b8950ea952476baea26e03281fa2f7640b6241ef.png)、$28$。
